summary.text: Michael Mebruer of St. Francisville is a Republican candidate who describes himself as a traveling medical professional and an economist with a master's degree in financial economics from LSU. He says his campaign is fully self-funded and focused on government efficiency and reducing federal debt.

paragraphs.text: Mebruer graduated from West Feliciana High School and earned a graduate degree from Louisiana State University in 2026; his campaign biography describes it as a master's degree in financial economics.
He works in healthcare as a traveling medical professional, with assignments that he says have taken him across the country, including Alaska.
He says his campaign is self-funded and that he is not taking donations.
One Louisiana Illuminator voter guide spells his surname "Mebreuer."

sources.title: New districts scramble candidate qualifying for Louisiana's US House races
